vector.note: members ascend by their own bytes, whatever order they arrived in
and members already in order are left exactly as they are
ordering holds at every depth rather than only at the top
there is one zero, and it carries no sign
a number is minimal, so leading zeroes are not part of it
and a plus is not part of it either
the largest whole number the form carries survives the round trip
and so does the smallest
a scalar that needs no escape is written as the character it names
and a control is written the one way, in lower case
an upper-case control escape is the same control, written the one way
anything that is not a control is emitted directly, as its own bytes
the quote and the reverse solidus are the two that stay escaped
and the solidus is not one of them
no byte of whitespace survives anywhere
an array keeps the order it was given, because its order is part of what it means
an empty object and an empty array are values rather than absences
the literals are lower case and there are three of them
the whole document need not be an object
nor a container at all
a character outside the basic plane is written as one character rather than as its two halves
